description_en: Queries the information about the minor version of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescrbeKernelVersion接口查看目标集群的内核版本信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-kernel-version --db-cluster-id amv-2ze918p6qf6h90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeKernelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.



You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看可用地域的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AvailableKernelVersions.description_en: The minor versions to which you can update the current minor version of the cluster
AvailableKernelVersions.description_zh: 当前版本支持升级到的目标版本列表

items.description_en: The minor versions to which you can update the current minor version of the cluster
items.description_zh: 当前版本支持升级到的目标版本列表

ExpireDate.description_en: The maintenance expiration time of the version. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. After the time arrives, the system no longer maintains the version. If any issues occur, update the minor version of the cluster to a later version
ExpireDate.description_zh: 版本维护到期时间，时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss。超过此时间后，系统将不再维护该版本，若有问题，请升级到更高版本

ReleaseDate.description_en: The time when the minor version was released. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ReleaseDate.description_zh: 内核版本的发布时间。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
